page.layout: One page with one table of years, in two blocks of 15 rows each, divided by a rule. Columns from left to right: Indict., An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon., Feriae (with Nou. markers spanning rows), Christi. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Gathering signature at foot centre.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriae | Christi.

page.notes: The Nou. entries are printed dashes with a number and "Nou." in the Feriae column, each spanning the rows of one run of feriae; they are kept as cells beside the row where they stand. The asterisk after 1213 is printed in the An. Iul. column as shown. Lines were read from the scan; no word is marked doubtful.
